result.description: Ingestion results. Present only when ok=true.

report_metadata.description: Metadata extracted from the source report.

page_count.description: Number of pages actually read and examined. Equal to pages_total unless max_pages capped the read.

pages_total.description: Pages the source document actually has. Any gap from page_count is content that was never examined.

pages_dropped.description: pages_total - page_count. Non-zero means incomplete coverage, so absence of an indicator is not evidence it is absent from the report.

campaign_name.description: Named campaign or operation if identified.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. 'low'=regex match only, 'medium'=regex + structural context, 'high'=LLM-confirmed.

context.description: Surrounding text or context where the IOC was found.

priority.description: Operational priority based on LLM assessment of the IOC's role in the described attack.

related_mitre.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs associated with this IOC.

defanged.description: True if the original value was defanged (e.g., hxxp://, [.]com) and has been re-fanged.

mitre_mappings.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques identified in the report. Identity key is (technique_id, tactic) — the same technique may appear multiple times with different tactics when it serves different roles across attack paths.

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g., T1566.001), in the vocabulary of the bundled ATT&CK release.

technique_id_retired_from.description: Present only when the ID arrived under numbering ATT&CK has since retired and was remapped (e.g. T1562.001 -> T1685). The technique is unchanged; only its ID is.

tactic.description: Parent tactic (e.g., Initial Access). Combined with technique_id forms the entry identity key.

confidence.description: 'explicit' if the technique ID appears in the report text. 'inferred' if the LLM mapped described behavior to a technique.

report_context.description: Brief excerpt or description of the behavior mapped to this technique.

context_paths.description: Attack graph path IDs where this (technique_id, tactic) pair appears. Absent for entries not linked to a graph step.

mitre_validated.description: True if the technique_id exists in the official MITRE ATT&CK matrix. False indicates the ID was generated by the LLM and does not correspond to an official technique — the associated behavior may still be accurate.

tactic_mismatch.description: Present and True when the assigned tactic is not in the official ATT&CK tactic list for this technique and could not be corrected deterministically. The technique_id is valid (mitre_validated=true) but the tactic needs analyst confirmation — see allowed_tactics. Absent when the tactic matches, was auto-corrected, or when no MITRE database is available.

allowed_tactics.description: Present only with tactic_mismatch=true: the tactics ATT&CK allows for this technique, so the analyst can pick one or confirm the LLM's label from the report.

tactic_corrected_from.description: Present when the reconciler replaced the LLM's tactic label deterministically (retired tactic, Stealth/Defense Impairment sibling swap, or a technique with a single valid tactic). Holds the original label.

ioc_breakdown.description: Count of IOCs by type, e.g., {"ip": 23, "domain": 12}.

mitre_technique_count.description: Total number of (technique_id, tactic) role entries.

document_profile.description: Deterministic pre-flight description of the document: pages, text size, regex candidate counts (total, by type, per page), estimated output tokens and a 'narrative' / 'ioc_dense' classification. Computed before any LLM call.

ingestion_plan.description: How the document was sent: strategy ('native', 'native_batched', 'chunked_text'), the page-range batches with candidate counts and estimates, and the reason.

timings.description: Seconds spent per phase: extract_s, native_s, chunks_s, reconcile_s, total_s.

tactic_corrected_count.description: Mapping entries whose tactic was corrected automatically against ATT&CK.

tactic_mismatch_count.description: Mapping entries whose tactic still needs analyst confirmation.

truncated.description: True when at least one chunk's reply stopped at the output cap, so its candidates were only partly assessed.

truncated_chunks.description: 1-based indices of the chunks that were cut off. Empty when none were.

analysis_status.description: Whether this run did the work it set out to do. complete: nothing truncated, no pages dropped, no fallback. partial: content is missing but every cause is known and named in analysis_notes. degraded: the tool fell back to a materially worse input path, so part of the output is not the kind of answer it normally produces.

analysis_notes.description: One short line per cause behind analysis_status. Rendered ahead of the content in summarize_for_llm, which PluginExecutor caps at 2000 characters.

chunks_attempted.description: How many chunked LLM calls this ingestion set out to make. 0 when the native path covered the whole document.

chunks_failed.description: Chunks that produced no usable result. Their candidates were never assessed, so a non-zero value makes analysis_status partial.

chunk_failure_breakdown.description: Why chunks failed, split by cause. A JSON parse failure means the model answered and the answer was unusable; an llm_call failure means it did not answer.

candidates_rejected.description: Candidates the model assessed as false positives. When every candidate is rejected the IOC list is legitimately empty and ingestion_mode stays 'llm'.

output_artifacts.description: Artifacts registered as output of this tool execution.
